severity.effect: Drop weapons, winded, bruised, dazed, knockdown
Deep wound, broken bone, smashed teeth
Arterial spray, internal bleed, spine shock

leg.1: Leg buckles — you stay up, barely.
leg.2: Knee pops; every step is a Glitch waiting.
leg.3: Femur complaint. Sprint is a fantasy.
leg.4: Femoral spray. Leg is a liability.
leg.6: Leg gone at the joint. Shock wave.
leg.7: Pelvis opened. You are not walking out.

torso.2: Something in the chest wall shifted wrong.
torso.3: Deep trunk wound. Every inhale hurts.
torso.4: Internal bleed. Suit is getting heavier.
torso.5: Organ creche or gut is open for business.

arm.1: Weapon hand goes numb — drop or fumble.
arm.2: Shoulder out of true. Grip is a suggestion.
arm.3: Arm bone shows. Firing stance is broken.
arm.4: Brachial jet. That arm is done for precision.
arm.5: Hand or forearm is no longer attached properly.
arm.6: Arm gone. Balance and aim both lie.

head.2: Jaw or brow cracked. Focus slips.
head.4: Eye or ear ruined. World tilts.
head.5: Face is a red map. Consciousness negotiates.
head.6: Skull open enough to see weather.
